name: Bosun’s Call (SHM Publishing)
body:
Price 3,000 gp; Aura faint illusion; CL 3th; Weight —

DESCRIPTION

An enchanted sailors whistle, the bosun’s call makes loud clear notes to signal commands at a distance. When used, the whistle’s notes are magically carried to all allies within five miles.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 1,500 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells clarion call
